title: Introduction to PHP Arrays
learning_outcomes: Explain what introduction to php arrays contributes to a PHP application.
Apply at least one of these concepts in a small example: indexed arrays.

content.intro: PHP arrays are ordered maps that can represent lists, keyed records, and nested collections. Keys, missing values, sorting, and transformation order all affect the resulting data. In this lesson, focus on indexed arrays; then compare it with associative arrays. Use the example to predict a result before checking it, and record one case where the behavior may differ.
content.why_it_matters: You will use introduction to php arrays when building readable, testable PHP programs. Its practical value is knowing which rule applies, what result to expect, and how to handle failure or unexpected input.

content_blocks.title: The core idea
content_blocks.text: PHP arrays are ordered maps that can represent lists, keyed records, and nested collections. Keys, missing values, sorting, and transformation order all affect the resulting data. For introduction to php arrays, begin with indexed arrays. Also distinguish associative arrays; array keys and values; array ordering.
